svg.title: MoonTelemetry corrected one-hour soak observations
svg.desc: Sampled whole-process RSS and input/file queue occupancy across sixty minutes, from retained synthetic workload evidence. Sampled observations do not prove absence of memory leaks or guarantee production capacity.

g.text: Whole-process RSS (MiB): includes the load generator; sampled observations
Queued batches: input (blue) and file target (orange); capacity 64 per queue
All server-admitted records delivered; zero final logical/request budget and shutdown loss.
Shared host with concurrent development. Source predates later float parsing/reporting changes.
Reproduce from retained raw JSON + progress NDJSON after running check_soak_results.mbtx.
